name: Crystian and Lost Crystals
storyline: Crystian and Lost Crystals tells the story of a boy who returns to the dangerous mines to recover his lost “crystals.” Between water, lava, wild animals, and unstable paths, Crystian searches for the stones that mean more to him than any real treasure. From the personal memory of his uncle grows a brave adventure – whoever explores carefully and survives the dangers helps Crystian reclaim something that is priceless to him.
